title.zh: 过程与框架作为一个展开的读法
title.en: Process and frame as readings of one unfolding

statement.zh: 动作读入配置，世界的动作是关系项的交换；历史是它所显示之律的运行，对应不是同一，差别是记忆；主张是关系项。
statement.en: The move is read within the configuration, a world's moves being its relata's exchanges; a history is a run of the law it shows, the correspondence not an identity, the gap being memory; a claim is a relatum.

claim.zh: 设 P 是配置类型 S、动作类型 A 上的过程。把动作读入配置（withMove P，配置为 S × A，只有一个标签），P 的运行就是同一个运行的两种读法（Run.toWithMove、Run.ofWithMove、Run.ofWithMove_toWithMove、Run.toWithMove_ofWithMove）；这时律留开下一个动作（withMove_open），它确定，恰当 P 确定且 P 取一步之处只有一个动作（withMove_determined_iff）。动作由配置的一个策略形成时（closedBy P policy），每一步都是动作留开时的一步（closedBy_withMove）；P 确定则它仍确定（closedBy_determined），从同一配置出发的两个运行每一步都相同（closedBy_runs_agree，经 Becoming.Mechanism 的 GoAlike.runs_agree）。忘掉 GenerativeCore 的 productProcess 中联合一步的动作，留下各部分忘掉动作后的一步（unlabelled_product_le）；Fork 中两个按同一律分岔的部分，共享动作时不能同时走不同的路，各自先忘掉动作时能（Fork.label_couples）。世界 w 中，从第 t 步起的动作是其关系项的交换（Exchange、World.move）：在场的关系项取与给什么。交换之律（exchange R）说：每个关系项在一步之后的水平连同从它被取的，等于之前的水平连同给它的。w 平衡，恰当其水平以其交换为动作按这条律运行（World.balances_iff_exchange，按定义）；跨一步，恰当它在那里的每个家族上平衡（World.exchange_step_iff）；这时 w 是这条律的运行（World.exchangeRun）。律固定一步之后的每个水平（exchange_agrees）；动作相同、起点在每个关系项上相同的两个运行，每一步在每个关系项上都相同（exchange_runs_agree）；Circulation 中一次循环与没有交换留下同样的水平（Circulation.standings_leave_exchange），动作相同而起点不同的运行每一步都不同（Circulation.start_needed）。对任何配置序列 g 与动作序列 m，它所显示的律（Shown g m）恰有它的各步；序列是它的运行（Shown.run），它是序列为其运行的最小的律（shown_le_iff），也包含在每个以这些配置与动作为运行的律之中（Run.shown_le）。Shown g m 确定，恰当序列一致：从不以同一动作把同一配置带到两处（Consistent、shown_determined_iff）；恰在这时有确定的律容许这个序列（exists_law_iff，经 Becoming.Mechanism 的 carries_law_iff 与 goAlike_id_iff）；容许它的每个确定的律在它的各步上与它相同（Shown.agrees）。对应不是同一：DeadEnd 中一条律有一步而没有运行（DeadEnd.no_history）；Splice 中重访一个配置的历史所显示的律容许一个运行，它从任何一步起都不是这段历史（Splice.spliced）；序列从不重访时，它所显示的律从它的某个配置出发的每个运行，都是从那里起的这个序列（eq_of_new、Shown.runs_of_new），所以沿保留历史的运行（Becoming.Experiment 的 keepHistory），它所显示的律只容许它（Run.keepHistory_shown）。对框架 F 与运行 r，F.world r 是一个世界：关系项是 F 的主张，每个恰在实现处活跃，没有流，没有立着、依存或汲取（Frame.world、Frame.world_active）；主张的生起就是它开始被实现（Frame.arises_iff）；一步之后的配置记录此前实现了什么时，某种读法的主张在该步之后是新的，恰当有一个跨这一步生起（Frame.novel_iff_arises）；在每步都可判定的有限主张家族中，开始被实现复现恰当不再被实现复现（Frame.claims_recur_iff，由 Becoming.Change 的 coming_recurs_iff）。以配置为主张（Frame.configurations），两个运行的世界在活动上相同，它们每一步都相同（Frame.world_fixes_run）。不用 Lean 公理。
claim.en: Let P be a process on configurations S with moves A. Read with the move inside the configuration (withMove P, on S × A with one label), P's runs are one run read two ways (Run.toWithMove, Run.ofWithMove, Run.ofWithMove_toWithMove, Run.toWithMove_ofWithMove); the law then leaves the next move open (withMove_open), and it is determined exactly where P is determined and, wherever P takes a step, only one move exists (withMove_determined_iff). Where the move is formed by a policy of the configuration (closedBy P policy), each step is a step of the law with the move left open (closedBy_withMove); a determined P stays determined (closedBy_determined), and two runs from one configuration agree at every step (closedBy_runs_agree, through GoAlike.runs_agree of Becoming.Mechanism). Forgetting the move of a joint step of GenerativeCore's productProcess leaves a step of each part with its move forgotten (unlabelled_product_le); in Fork two parts forking by one law cannot go different ways at once with the move shared, and can with the move forgotten in each part first (Fork.label_couples). In a world w the move across the step from t is its relata's exchange (Exchange, World.move): what the relata present take and give. The law of exchange (exchange R) says that each relatum's standing after a step with what is taken from it equals its standing before with what is given to it. w balances exactly where its standings run by this law with its exchanges as moves (World.balances_iff_exchange, by definition), across one step exactly where it balances on every family there (World.exchange_step_iff), and is then a run of the law (World.exchangeRun). The law fixes each standing after a step (exchange_agrees); two runs with the same moves, starting alike at every relatum, agree at every relatum at every step (exchange_runs_agree); in Circulation a circulation and no exchange leave the same standings (Circulation.standings_leave_exchange), and runs with the same moves from different starts differ at every step (Circulation.start_needed). For any sequence of configurations g and moves m, the law it shows (Shown g m) has exactly its steps; the sequence is a run of it (Shown.run), it is the least law the sequence is a run of (shown_le_iff), and it lies within every law of which a run has these configurations and moves (Run.shown_le). Shown g m is determined exactly where the sequence is consistent, never taking one move at one configuration to two outcomes (Consistent, shown_determined_iff), and exactly then some determined law admits the sequence (exists_law_iff, through carries_law_iff and goAlike_id_iff of Becoming.Mechanism); every determined law admitting it agrees with it on its steps (Shown.agrees). The correspondence is not an identity: in DeadEnd a law has a step and no run (DeadEnd.no_history); in Splice a history that revisits a configuration shows a law admitting a run that is the history from no step on (Splice.spliced); where a sequence never revisits, every run of the law it shows from one of its configurations is the sequence from there on (eq_of_new, Shown.runs_of_new), so along a run keeping its history (keepHistory of Becoming.Experiment) the law it shows admits only it (Run.keepHistory_shown). For a frame F and a run r, F.world r is a world whose relata are F's claims, each active exactly where realized, with no flow and nothing standing, depending or drawing (Frame.world, Frame.world_active); a claim arises exactly where it comes to be realized (Frame.arises_iff); where the configuration after a step records what was realized before it, a claim of a reading is new after the step exactly where one arises across it (Frame.novel_iff_arises); in a finite family of claims decided at each step, coming to be realized recurs exactly where ceasing to be realized recurs (Frame.claims_recur_iff, by coming_recurs_iff of Becoming.Change). With the configurations as claims (Frame.configurations), two runs whose worlds agree in activity agree at every step (Frame.world_fixes_run). No Lean axiom is used.

hypotheses.zh: 不加前提；每条定理所用的局部条件写在其中：exists_law_iff 与 shown_determined_iff 是双向的，对每个序列成立；closedBy_runs_agree 要 P 确定与相同的起点；exchange_runs_agree 要相同的动作与在每个关系项上相同的起点；Shown.runs_of_new 要序列从不重访；Frame.novel_iff_arises 要一步之后的配置记录此前的实现；Frame.claims_recur_iff 要有限的主张列表与每步的可判定性。
hypotheses.en: No premise; each theorem's local conditions are written into it: exists_law_iff and shown_determined_iff are two-way and hold of every sequence; closedBy_runs_agree needs P determined and the same start; exchange_runs_agree needs the same moves and starts alike at every relatum; Shown.runs_of_new needs the sequence never to revisit; Frame.novel_iff_arises needs the configuration after a step to record what was realized before it; Frame.claims_recur_iff needs a finite list of claims decided at each step.

hypotheses.zh: 把动作读入配置与形成动作的策略都是给出的读法，不推出动作在展开之内形成、由什么形成；交换之律把世界的流读作它的动作。
hypotheses.en: Reading the move within the configuration, and the policy forming the move, are readings supplied; that a move is formed within the unfolding, or by what, is not derived; the law of exchange reads a world's flow as its moves.

hypotheses.zh: 律指确定的过程（Becoming.Joint 的 Determined）；运行是无穷的（Becoming.Frame 的 Run），所以律走进死路的一步不在任何运行上。
hypotheses.en: A law is a determined process (Determined of Becoming.Joint); runs are infinite (Run of Becoming.Frame), so a law's step into a dead end lies on no run.

hypotheses.zh: 见证的结论：Fork、Splice、DeadEnd 与 Circulation 的过程、序列与运行。
hypotheses.en: For the witnesses: the processes, sequences and runs of Fork, Splice, DeadEnd and Circulation.

hypotheses.zh: 离散的步（从第 0 步计）；自然数的量；共同的步序；Frame.world 中主张的类型在 Type 中，与 World 的关系项一样。
hypotheses.en: Discrete steps, counted from step 0; natural-number amounts; a shared index of steps; in Frame.world the claims form a type in Type, as World's relata do.

correspondence.zh: Ren 2026-10-12 问核心的前两层“is this dualistic?”；对 AI 的回答（它们不设主体与客体，但其形式把四种分割当作给定：配置与另一字母表的动作、先于历史的律、从配置读出的主张、先于关系的配置；提议从 World 重述它们，GenerativeCore 不变）答：“yes, put it on the board and start”（工作板 P69）。在同一对话的另一分支上，对律与历史是同一展开的两种读法、律从展开读出而不是置于其上这一读法，Ren 写道：“yes, i do agree with your reading, there are no two realities”。DeadEnd、Splice、保留历史、Fork 与 Circulation 的结果是那个分支上检查过的定理在本模块定义上的重述。读法（AI 的，待 Ren）：World 是核心的起点，带标签的过程是把配置分为律所固定者与所留开者的读法，框架是经主张读的世界；行动不是展开之外的第二种原因，变动自己的行动就是变动配置之所是；律与历史之间的差别是记忆：律从所在之处回答，不从怎样来到那里回答；认识在展开之内，主张与任何东西一样在同样的规律下生起与止息。见整合文档 §91。
correspondence.en: On 12 October 2026 Ren asked of the core's first two layers “is this dualistic?”, and to the AI's answer (they posit no subject and object, but their form takes four splits as given: a configuration and a move from an alphabet of its own, a law prior to the history, claims read off a configuration, and configurations prior to their relation; the proposal was to restate them from World, leaving GenerativeCore unchanged) answered “yes, put it on the board and start” (work-board item P69). On another branch of the same conversation, of the reading that law and history are one unfolding read two ways, the law read off the unfolding rather than set over it, Ren wrote “yes, i do agree with your reading, there are no two realities”. The results on DeadEnd, Splice, kept history, Fork and Circulation restate on this module's definitions theorems checked on that branch. Readings (the AI's, pending Ren): World is where the core begins, a labelled process is the reading that splits the configuration into what the law fixes and what it leaves open, and a frame is a world read through its claims; an agent's choice is not a second kind of cause beside the unfolding, and varying one's own act is varying what the configuration is; the gap between a law and its histories is memory: a law answers from where one is, not from how one came there; knowing is within the unfolding, a claim coming to be and ceasing under the same laws as anything else. See §91 of the integration note.

detail.zh: 复用 World、Flow.Balances、Flow.BalancesOn 与 Web.Arises：世界的动作读作其关系项的交换，平衡恰是按交换之律运行；框架沿运行读作一个世界，主张的生起是 Web.Arises。
detail.en: Reuses World, Flow.Balances, Flow.BalancesOn and Web.Arises: a world's moves are read as its relata's exchanges, and balance is running by the law of exchange; a frame along a run is read as a world, a claim's arising being Web.Arises.

output.zh: 世界：关系项、流与依存网；平衡与一步上家族的平衡；生起。
output.en: The world: relata, flow and web; balance, and balance on a family at a step; arising.

input.en: World.move, World.balances_iff_exchange, World.exchange_step_iff; Frame.world and Frame.arises_iff.

detail.zh: 复用 carries_law_iff 与 goAlike_id_iff：有确定的律容许历史恰当历史一致（exists_law_iff），因为 Shown g m 是它分解到的最小过程；复用 GoAlike.runs_agree：动作在内形成时运行相同（closedBy_runs_agree）。
detail.en: Reuses carries_law_iff and goAlike_id_iff: some determined law admits a history exactly where it is consistent (exists_law_iff), Shown g m being the least process it factors through; reuses GoAlike.runs_agree: with the move formed within, runs agree (closedBy_runs_agree).

output.zh: 投影承载规律的刻画；相同者同去时运行相同。
output.en: The characterization of a projection carrying a law; runs agree where configurations alike go alike.

input.zh: 历史所显示之律的确定性；动作在内形成的运行。
input.en: Determinacy of the law a history shows; runs with the move formed within.

detail.zh: 复用 keepHistory 与 keepHistory_new：保留历史的运行从不重访，所以它所显示的律只容许它（Run.keepHistory_shown）。先于历史给出的律所多出的，是它未取的动作，记录不固定它们（Run.not_fixes_of_untaken，读法中引用）。
detail.en: Reuses keepHistory and keepHistory_new: a run keeping its history never revisits, so the law it shows admits only it (Run.keepHistory_shown). What a law supplied before the history adds is its moves not taken, which the record does not fix (Run.not_fixes_of_untaken, cited in the reading).

output.zh: 保留历史的过程；保留的历史每一步都是新的。
output.en: The process keeping its history; a kept history is new at every step.

input.zh: 保留历史时律与历史的对应。
input.en: The correspondence of law and history where the history is kept.

detail.zh: 复用 Determined：律指确定的过程；动作读入配置后的确定性（withMove_determined_iff），历史所显示之律的确定性（shown_determined_iff）。
detail.en: Reuses Determined: a law is a determined process; determinacy with the move inside (withMove_determined_iff), and of the law a history shows (shown_determined_iff).

detail.zh: 复用 ComesToBe、CeasesToBe、Recurs 与 coming_recurs_iff：主张是关系项，开始被实现复现恰当不再被实现复现（Frame.claims_recur_iff）。
detail.en: Reuses ComesToBe, CeasesToBe, Recurs and coming_recurs_iff: claims are relata, and coming to be realized recurs exactly where ceasing to be realized recurs (Frame.claims_recur_iff).

output.zh: 有限家族中开始成立与不再成立同步。
output.en: In a finite family coming to be and ceasing to be keep pace.

input.en: The laws of activity for claims.

conditions.zh: 有限的主张列表，每步可判定。
conditions.en: A finite list of claims, decided at each step.

detail.zh: 同一模块的第四项：配置由它怎样关系而定；交换之律下水平相同恰当在每个关系项上相等。
detail.en: The fourth item in the same module: a configuration is how it relates; under the law of exchange standings are alike exactly where they agree at every relatum.

detail.zh: 保留历史的代价：Law.withHistory_never_returns 与 withHistory_unlisted，保留的历史从不返回，没有列表持有它。律只容许保留的历史（Run.keepHistory_shown）与它从不返回是同一事实的两面。
detail.en: The price of keeping the history: Law.withHistory_never_returns and withHistory_unlisted, a kept history never returns and no list holds it. That the law admits only the kept history (Run.keepHistory_shown) and that it never returns are two sides of one fact.

detail.zh: 外围：同一状态与动作类型上的两个过程逐步相同，恰当它们的有限带标签轨迹（端点都保留）相同。这里说的是一段无穷历史与它所显示的律：最小的律，以及两者的对应何处不是同一。
detail.en: Periphery: two processes on the same state and move types agree step by step exactly where they agree on all finite labelled traces with both endpoints. Here the subject is one infinite history and the law it shows: the least law, and where the correspondence is not an identity.

detail.zh: 外围：从有限历史的语言与摘要构造的局部律，恰在共享代码的历史有相同延续时保留全部有限延续。Shown.runs_of_new 是核心中的一种情形：配置从不重复时，所显示的律只容许这段历史。
detail.en: Periphery: the local law built from a language of finite histories and a summary keeps every finite continuation exactly where histories sharing a code have the same continuations. Shown.runs_of_new is a case in the core: where the configuration never repeats, the law shown admits only the history.

detail.zh: 标签不承载任何东西；这里动作作为标签读入配置时没有失去什么，而部分之间共享的动作是一种关系（Fork.label_couples）。
detail.en: Labels carry nothing; here the move read as a label into the configuration loses nothing, while a move shared between parts is a relation (Fork.label_couples).

detail.zh: 标准因果模型中动作是输入与噪声；这里动作读入配置时，律所留开的就是它们，由策略在内形成时律仍确定。
detail.en: In standard causal models the move is the input and the noise; here, with the move read within the configuration, they are what the law leaves open, and with a policy forming them within the law stays determined.

detail.zh: 实例（P80b）：交换律的进程是一个世界，按交换之律而行恰当可行；确定的律在 Shown 之外的步恰在运行未取的动作（Run.beyond_shown_iff，关于 Shown 的一条律，暂放在 Counterfactual），所以进程历史之外的是反事实；部分的动作由律在配置上形成时，closedBy 的运行就是进程。
detail.en: Instances (P80b): the course of a law of exchange is a world, running by the law of exchange exactly where feasible; a determined law's steps beyond Shown are exactly at the moves the run never takes (Run.beyond_shown_iff, a law about Shown, kept in Counterfactual for now), so what lies beyond the course's history is its counterfactuals; with the part's move formed by a law on the configuration, a run of closedBy is the course.

detail.zh: 律到历史有所失：DeadEnd 中律有一步而没有任何运行（DeadEnd.no_history）。
detail.en: Law to histories loses: in DeadEnd a law has a step and no run at all (DeadEnd.no_history).

detail.zh: 历史到律有所得：Splice 中历史重访起点，它所显示的律容许在前两个配置之间往返的运行，它从任何一步起都不是这段历史（Splice.spliced）。
detail.en: History to law gains: in Splice the history revisits its start, and the law it shows admits a run going back and forth between the first two configurations, which is the history from no step on (Splice.spliced).

detail.zh: 共享的动作是部分之间的关系：Fork 中先忘掉各自的动作，两个部分就能同时走不同的路（Fork.label_couples）。
detail.en: A shared move is a relation between parts: in Fork, with each part's move forgotten first, the two can go different ways at once (Fork.label_couples).

detail.zh: 水平不固定交换，交换只从一个起点固定水平：Circulation 中一次循环与没有交换留下同样的水平，动作相同而起点不同的运行处处不同（Circulation.standings_leave_exchange、Circulation.start_needed）。
detail.en: Standings do not fix the exchange, and the exchange fixes standings only from a beginning: in Circulation a circulation and no exchange leave the same standings, and runs with the same moves from different starts differ everywhere (Circulation.standings_leave_exchange, Circulation.start_needed).

limitations.zh: 共同的步序是表示的承诺，不由关系推出（见 Becoming.Sampling 与 Becoming.Tower）；动作在展开之内形成与否、由什么形成，一个形成把它的历史读作显示哪条律，都不推出；律只指确定的过程，概率没有陈述；GenerativeCore 不变，其中的过程仍以带标签的形式陈述，这里给出的是读法与桥接，不是另一个基础；Frame.world 不含流与依存，主张之间的关系没有陈述；主定理多近于定义，增量在于两个方向都证明、对应何处不是同一，以及代价；读法是 AI 的，Ren 只确认了律与历史的读法；不含伦理谓词。
limitations.en: The shared index of steps is a commitment of the representation and is not derived from relations (see Becoming.Sampling and Becoming.Tower); that a move is formed within the unfolding, or by what, and which law a formation takes its history to show, are not derived; a law means a determined process, and probabilities are not treated; GenerativeCore is unchanged and still states processes in labelled form, so what is given here is a reading and a bridge, not another foundation; Frame.world has no flow or web, and relations among claims are not stated; most main theorems are near-definitional, the delta being that both directions are proved, where the correspondence fails to be an identity, and its price; the readings are the AI's, Ren having confirmed only the reading of law and history; contains no ethical predicate.

next_delta.zh: 从关系推出共同的步序，或说明它为何是表示的承诺；动作在展开之内形成的条件（何时一个动作是某个形成的，而不是外来的）；主张之间的关系作为 Frame.world 的流与依存；Ren 的判断：起点是否读作 World，过程与框架是否读作它的读法。
next_delta.en: Deriving the shared index of steps from relations, or saying why it is a commitment of the representation; when a move is formed within the unfolding (when it is a formation's, not supplied from outside); relations among claims as the flow and web of Frame.world; Ren's judgment whether the starting point reads as World, with the process and the frame as its readings.
